helm_deliverable: Professional repo hygiene for Helm with Conventional Commits, commit best practices, and PR template
description: Master professional commit message conventions and pull request templates. Learn to write clear, concise commit messages following the Conventional Commits specification. Create PR templates that streamline code review and maintain high-quality documentation. Establish the repository hygiene patterns that will support Helm's evolution across all phases.
learning_objectives: Understand the value of consistent commit message format for project history
Write commit messages following Conventional Commits specification
Apply the 50/72 rule for subject lines and body formatting
Use imperative mood correctly in commit subjects
Write commit bodies that explain motivation and context
Understand atomic commits and use git commit --amend
Create GitHub PR templates with consistent structure
Write clear PR descriptions that facilitate code review
Link commits and PRs to issues using GitHub syntax
Apply all conventions to Helm development work

lessons.title: The 50/72 Rule — Writing Clear Commit Subject Lines
Commit Bodies and Footers — Explaining the Why
Anatomy of an Effective Pull Request
Repository Hygiene Capstone — Putting It All Together
